title: Alkansas Utility
description: This mod makes sutil utilities to minecraft like dont have to press f in the inventory to put t0t3ms in your offhand.
body:
# Alkansas Utilities
Adds a quick offhand swap feature, letting you place items into your offhand instantly without pressing the F key.
- In v1 only supports one item. (T0t3m)
- 0 Ticks D3lay
- Lightweight Mod
